object:slippery cloak / oilskin cloak.visualDescription: A taupe slippery cloak hangs from a narrow collar, with rounded sleeves and a dark central opening.
object:slippery cloak / oilskin cloak.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies oilskin cloak as a cloth outer garment that repels water and appears as a slippery cloak.
object:slippery cloak / oilskin cloak.modelBrief: Model a draped beige-taupe waterproof cloak with subtle sheen, keeping its center open.

object:robe.visualDescription: A vivid blue robe has a rounded hood, wide sleeves, and a pointed open front.
object:robe.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies the robe as a magical cloth cloak that can be worn over body armor.
object:robe.modelBrief: Build a long blue hooded robe with broad bell sleeves and deep dark folds.

object:apron / alchemy smock.visualDescription: A plain tan apron has broad shoulders, dark neck opening, and a long rectangular lower panel.
object:apron / alchemy smock.wikiDescription: The wiki says the alchemy smock is a protective cloth cloak that appears as an apron when unidentified.
object:apron / alchemy smock.modelBrief: Make a simple long pale-tan apron or smock with a neck strap and flat front, without laboratory symbols.

object:leather cloak.visualDescription: A dark brown leather cloak has a narrow upper collar, flowing shoulder panels, and open middle.
object:leather cloak.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies a leather cloak as a leather outer garment.
object:leather cloak.modelBrief: Build a thick russet leather cape with a collar, broad drape, and dark central gap.

object:tattered cape / cloak of protecti.visualDescription: A ragged tan cape has a short collar, torn lower points, and dark brown inner shadow.
object:tattered cape / cloak of protecti.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies the cloak of protection as a magical cloth cloak; its default unidentified appearance is a tattered cape. This magical item can have another unidentified appearance when appearances are shuffled.
object:tattered cape / cloak of protecti.modelBrief: Model a worn sand-colored cape with irregular frayed hem, not a visible force-field effect. Keep the item identity separate from this appearance asset.

object:opera cloak / cloak of invisibili.visualDescription: A black and wine-red opera cloak has a high rounded collar and deep red inner lining.
object:opera cloak / cloak of invisibili.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies the cloak of invisibility as magical cloth; opera cloak is its default unidentified description. This magical item can have another unidentified appearance when appearances are shuffled.
object:opera cloak / cloak of invisibili.modelBrief: Build a theatrical black cape with burgundy lining and tall collar, without making the garment itself disappear. Keep the item identity separate from this appearance asset.

object:ornamental cope / cloak of magic.visualDescription: A purple ceremonial cope has a stiff high collar, gold horizontal trim, and a dark center opening.
object:ornamental cope / cloak of magic.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies the cloak of magic resistance as a magical cloth cloak defaulting to an ornamental cope. This magical item can have another unidentified appearance when appearances are shuffled.
object:ornamental cope / cloak of magic.modelBrief: Model a formal violet cope with gold neck band and broad symmetric drapes; keep magical protection invisible. Keep the item identity separate from this appearance asset.

sources.label: NetHack Wiki: Cloak of magic resistance

object:piece of cloth / cloak of displac.visualDescription: A crumpled blue-gray cloth piece has jagged folded edges and teal patches, without a fitted collar.
object:piece of cloth / cloak of displac.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies the cloak of displacement as a magical cloak whose default unidentified appearance is a piece of cloth. This magical item can have another unidentified appearance when appearances are shuffled.
object:piece of cloth / cloak of displac.modelBrief: Make an irregular folded cloth bundle in blue and teal; do not add a second displaced silhouette to the physical asset. Keep the item identity separate from this appearance asset.

object:wooden shield / small shield.visualDescription: A small brown wooden shield has a flat upper edge, tapered bottom, and narrow vertical plank highlights.
object:wooden shield / small shield.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies the small shield as a wooden shield that appears simply as a wooden shield when unidentified.
object:wooden shield / small shield.modelBrief: Build a compact tapered wooden shield with vertical grain and dark edge, matching the shared appearance of nearby wooden-shield tiles.

object:wooden shield / shield of drain r.visualDescription: The tile repeats the same small brown tapered wooden shield with vertical plank highlights.
object:wooden shield / shield of drain r.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies the shield of drain resistance as wooden armor that appears as a wooden shield when unidentified.
object:wooden shield / shield of drain r.modelBrief: Reuse the plain wooden shield mesh and palette; attach drain resistance only as item data.

sources.label: NetHack Wiki: Shield of drain resistance

object:wooden shield / shield of shock r.visualDescription: The tile again shows the same small brown wooden shield with a flat top and tapered lower point.
object:wooden shield / shield of shock r.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies the shield of shock resistance as wooden armor that appears as a wooden shield when unidentified.
object:wooden shield / shield of shock r.modelBrief: Reuse the same compact wooden shield appearance; do not add lightning art to the model.

sources.label: NetHack Wiki: Shield of shock resistance

object:blue and green shield / elven shi.visualDescription: A pointed shield has a dark blue rim, saturated green face, and a pale green horizontal stripe near its top.
object:blue and green shield / elven shi.wikiDescription: The wiki says the elven shield is wooden and appears as a blue and green shield when unidentified.
object:blue and green shield / elven shi.modelBrief: Make a slender pointed elven shield with blue border, green face, and single bright horizontal accent.
